mapper.select: SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, a.name, s.title, al.cover_image_url, sc.total_score FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN ( SELECT song_id, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM song_score_tbl WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7 AND created_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY song_id ) sc ON s.song_id = sc.song_id ORDER BY sc.total_score DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, a.name, s.title, al.cover_image_url, sc.total_score FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN ( SELECT song_id, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM song_score_tbl WHERE created_at >= SYSDATE - 1 AND created_at < SYSDATE GROUP BY song_id ) sc ON s.song_id = sc.song_id ORDER BY sc.total_score DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, a.name, s.title, al.cover_image_url, sc.total_score FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN song_genre_tbl sg ON s.song_id = sg.song_id JOIN ( SELECT song_id, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM song_score_tbl WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7 AND created_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY song_id ) sc ON s.song_id = sc.song_id WHERE sg.genre_id = #{genreId} ORDER BY sc.total_score DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song_score_tbl ( user_id, song_id, score, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{songId}, #{score}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.song_id, s.artist_id, s.title, a.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, g.name AS genre_name, g.genre_id, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path FROM song_score_tbl ss JOIN songs_tbl s ON ss.song_id = s.song_id JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN song_genre_tbl sg ON s.song_id = sg.song_id JOIN genres_tbl g ON sg.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE ss.user_id = #{userId} AND ss.score = 300 ORDER BY s.song_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song_score_tbl ( user_id, song_id, score, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{songId}, 300, SYSDATE )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlists_tbl ( user_id, title, list_type ) VALUES ( #{userId}, '_LIKE_', 'LIKE' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, s.title, a.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id WHERE s.song_id = #{songId}

SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, s.title, a.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, LISTAGG(g.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY g.name) AS genre_name, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path, COUNT(DISTINCT sg.genre_id) AS match_genre_count FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN song_genre_tbl sg ON s.song_id = sg.song_id JOIN genres_tbl g ON sg.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE s.song_id != #{songId} AND sg.genre_id IN ( SELECT genre_id FROM song_genre_tbl WHERE song_id = #{songId} ) GROUP BY s.song_id, s.artist_id, s.title, a.name, al.title, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sg.genre_id) DESC, s.song_id DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
SELECT artist_id, name, profile_image_url FROM artists_tbl WHERE artist_id = #{artistId}

SELECT s.song_id, s.album_id, s.artist_id, sg.genre_id, s.title, a.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, gt.name AS genre_name, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id LEFT JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id LEFT JOIN song_genre_tbl sg ON s.song_id = sg.song_id LEFT JOIN genres_tbl gt ON sg.genre_id = gt.genre_id WHERE s.artist_id = #{artistId} ORDER BY s.song_id DESC

SELECT s.song_id, s.artist_id, s.title, a.name AS artist_name, al.title AS album_title, al.cover_image_url, s.song_path FROM songs_tbl s JOIN artists_tbl a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id LEFT JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id WHERE LOWER(s.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{key}) || '%' OR LOWER(a.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER('psy') || '%' ORDER BY s.song_id DESC
